'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a researcher located at a Roya camp in the Roya Frostlands.

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:;'''Barrie''' Sir, what were the frostlands like before the Lament? Could you tell the story again?
:;'''Orson''' Back then, the water was clear, and the air was full of peace.

==Dialogue==
:'''Barrie''' Sir, what were the frostlands like before the Lament? Could you tell the story again?
:'''Orson''' Before the Lament... Ah. Back then, the Roya Frostlands were all fjords and vast forests. Peaceful. Serene. Endless...
:'''Orson''' We roamed the forests and fjords, living off the land, guided by our deer. We drove our sleds through glacial valleys... 
:'''Orson''' Back then, the water was clear, and the air was full of peace... The white moon shone on the earth, holding the memories of our people...
:'''Orson''' Then… they fell. Those "giants." Like stars, crashing down upon the frostlands.
:'''Barrie''' The Lament shifted Solaris's axis and magnetic poles. Roya forests became the new south pole. Then came the first wave of extinctions.
:'''Barrie''' The geomagnetic chaos that followed caused satellites and space stations orbiting Solaris to fall.
:'''Orson''' These giant wrecks became shelters from the cold for the Roya, allowing one tribe to survive.
:'''Orson''' But as for the others... They were not so lucky... Sigh.
:'''Barrie''' I'm sorry. I shouldn't have asked... It must be hard to talk about.
:'''Orson''' Oh, it's all right, young man. It's just a story passed down from my great-great-grandfather...
:'''Orson''' I've spent most of my life trudging through ice and snow. What do you think? Will I ever have a chance to see the Roya forests again?
:'''Barrie''' Of course!
{{Dialogue End}}
